title: Indian Food Nutrition Dataset: 63 Dishes, Recipe-Level, USDA-Sourced
description:
Calories, protein, carbohydrate and fat for 63 common Indian dishes, in 128 rows: the home version of every dish, plus restaurant and dhaba versions where the kitchen changes the dish. Each row is a stated recipe in grams, valued ingredient by ingredient from USDA FoodData Central, with the USDA record IDs listed so every figure can be checked. IFCT 2017 (ICMR-National Institute of Nutrition) is used as a cross reference.

Published figures for Indian dishes disagree widely because almost none state a recipe or a serving weight. This dataset states both. Servings are given in grams, and dals and curries are counted by the katori (150 ml), the small thali bowl.

Columns: dish, slug, family, preparation, serving, serving_g, serving_ml, kcal, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, kcal_per_100g, protein_g_per_100g, carbs_g_per_100g, fat_g_per_100g, fdc_ids, confidence, updated, url.

Known limits: these are recipe estimates, not lab measurements of plates. One recipe stands for each preparation. USDA values are mostly for US ingredients. The confidence label is a judgement of how well the recipe is anchored, not a statistical interval. Not medical or dietary advice.

Source and updates: https://getkatori.com/data (the dish pages show every recipe; every change is logged in a public corrections log).
